summary: std/csv: a `csv.reader`'s fields are valid UTF-8 (decision 0259): a file's bytes that are not UTF-8 became Str fields unchecked, so the 7 byte file `"x""\x82"` read and written back with `csv.format` faulted
details: a `csv.reader`'s fields are valid UTF-8 (decision 0259): a file's bytes that are not UTF-8 became Str fields unchecked, so the 7 byte file `"x""\x82"` read and written back with `csv.format` faulted; each byte of an invalid sequence is now U+FFFD, error columns stay Go's. A line longer than the read buffer was searched and copied again after every 64 KiB read, quadratic (a 128 MB line 1,489 ms, now 27 ms). Affected: 0.38.0 to 0.51.1.
